resources.string: Remaps the OnePlus Pad 3 keyboard: the bot key becomes a real Super, Esc becomes a real Escape, the top row becomes F1-F12, and holding Search (Fn) restores each top-row key\'s original action. One master switch, applied at boot.
Esc sends a real Escape · the top row sends F1–F12 · the bot key sends a real Super · holding Search (Fn) restores brightness, media and volume
Every key behaves as it did before this module existed, including the bot key\'s OnePlus gesture and the top row\'s brightness and media keys.
